mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite labor market improvement.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the previous 6 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of periods with strong RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite supply contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 70% of triggered instances despite tightening and inflation.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, the combination signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite strong labor market signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 6 months signals strong demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of periods with strong HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite economic weakening.
